text:
maya: Drafting internal RN and announce slate for tonight's small rollout—asking ops for pin + deploybot schedule. Quick summary: model pin to open-llm/v2-2026-03, batching default tuned to 32, canary 10% for 30m with auto-fallback. Draft below, pls +1 or call out issues.

maya: DRAFT RN (internal):
- What: Pin to open-llm/v2-2026-03 for text-generation workload. Runtime change: set default batch_size=32 to reduce tail lat.
- Why: regression fix for tokeniser edge-case + 5-10% cost improvement on our steady prompts.
- Impact: expected +20ms median latency, reduce P99 by ~30ms due to batching.
- Rollout: canary 10% for 30m -> 50% for 15m -> full. Fallback policy: immediate rollback to open-llm/v2-2026-02 on error spike or SLO breach.
- Rollback criteria: error rate >1% OR token-level latency increase >25% sustained over 1 min.
- Ops notes: pin service-config to tag v2026-03-pin, notify customers if we hit rollback.

maya: Can someone pin the RN in the staff doc and trigger the deploybot when ready? @fran @sam

sam: quick read — text looks fine. Two asks: confirm exact model sha and confirm the staging smoke checklist runbook. Also please add a short blurb for support (one-liner).

maya: model sha = abc123def456 (pushed to model-registry). Support blurb: "No customer facing API changes. Monitoring in place; support on standby." Added to the doc.

fran: Canary schedule sounds good. Add an SRE watch for connection errors + kv-cache growth. If p50 latency > baseline +40ms or error rate >1% cancel canary and rollback. :eyes:

leah: From product side — ok with messaging. Recommend we also include a single example of a prompt that could trigger the tokenizer edge-case so we can test in staging. I'll paste it in doc.

oliver: I'll own oncall for the window. Suggest we hold a 5-min preflight at T-10. Can someone kick off deploybot 15m before the slot so we can run the smoke script?

maya: yep preflight at T-10 and smoke script is `scripts/release_smoke.sh` (runs end-to-end).

deploy-bot: Scheduling request received. Proposed timeline:
- 2026-03-21T19:00:00Z -> schedule deploy to staging (canary 10%)
- 19:30:00Z -> promote to 50% if no alerts
- 19:45:00Z -> full rollout
Deploy command (dry-run):
```
/deploy --env staging --model open-llm/v2-2026-03@abc123def456 --canary 10% --canary-duration 30m --tag v2026-03-pin --notes "batch_size=32; fix tokenizer"
```

deploy-bot: To actually execute, run `/deploy confirm 7555554321` in this thread. I will post status updates and final event links.

sam: Adding rollback play: if rollback triggered, run:
```
/deploy --env prod --model open-llm/v2-2026-02 --tag rollback-7555554321
```
and alert #incidents.

fran: small nit — update RN line about metrics dashboards: include direct links to the p99/p50 dashboard and the new KV cache gauge. I'll add links and then we can pin. :white_check_mark:

maya: Thanks all. I'll update the doc with model sha, support blurb, smoke example, and dashboard links. Once fran adds dashboards and oliver confirms preflight, can someone run `/deploy confirm 7555554321` 15m before 19:00 UTC?

oliver: will do. ping me at T-20.

maya: tagging final checklist: pin RN doc, add deploybot confirm, preflight @ T-10, oncall @standby, monitoring hooks live. Thanks! :rocket:
